Your area of application

Owncompany IT@M, Customer Management, Customer Center 1 - KVR and FireDepartment, Agnes-Pockels-Bogen 21-33, 80992 Munich

The state capital of Munich

The ITdepartment is responsible for and shapes the entire IT of the Cityof Munich. We ensure that IT provision meets the city's current andfuture needs.

We drive the digitalization of the city of Munich andplay a pioneering role. Our work and our services... make the city ofMunich a digital metropolis that sets standards that its employeesare proud of.

As part of the IT department, we ensure amodern IT and telecommunications infrastructure, implementprofessional IT solutions and secure the IT operations of the Cityof Munich with over 1,200 employees in our own company it@M.

What you can expect

Asa DevOps Engineer, you will find yourself in an exciting workenvironment that includes optimizing existing applications as wellas implementing and planning (new) IT solutions.

As part of DevOps,you will also be responsible for operating Linux servers, whichalso includes analyzing and eliminating faults (service requests,2nd / 3rd level support, etc.).

Your tasks will includethe operation and maintenance of IT systems for the specialistprocedures supported in the service area (including trade,restaurants, weapons, regulatory offenses, lost property managementand fire inspection).

This includes monitoring and troubleshooting,ensuring the required availability, carrying out operationalsecurity measures (e.

g. installing releases from internal andexternal process manufacturers, restarting applications) and systemoptimizations.

In all these activities, you will alwayswork together with your team colleagues and in close coordinationwith our customers in the district administration department andthe fire department, the external product manufacturers, theinternal and external partner procedures and our infrastructureteams.

Occasionally, the job requires you towork outside of core working hours. This can occasionally lead toweekend work or on-call duty.

What we offeryou
• Independent, autonomousprocessing of your own area of responsibility
• a permanent position in EGr. 11 (depending on experiencelevel from € 4,032.38 to € 5,975.19 gross per month for full-timeemployment)
• Annual special payment as wellas an attractive company pension scheme, capital-forming benefits,a local and family allowance, coverage of the Deutschlandticket Jobor subsidy for the IsarCardJob (tax-free) and performance-relatedpay
• Possibility to rent a company apartmentfrom LHM
• A good work-life balance throughflexible working hours, forms of work (e.g. mobile working, homeoffice) and individually selectable working time models
• Reserved childcare places in municipal crèches,kindergartens and after-school care centers
• a wide range of training and development opportunities (individualdevelopment opportunities, excellent formats and modern forms oflearning)
• Internal development opportunities- a wide range of departments and specialist areas promise avariety of tasks
• Comprehensive companyhealth management

You have
• a successfully completeduniversity degree in the field of computer science, administrativeinformatics or business informatics or
• asuccessfully completed university degree or equivalent skills andexperience
• several years (at least two years) ofprofessional experience in the administration of IT solutions

In particular, you will have
• Specialist knowledge : Severalyears (at least two years) of experience in life cycle managementof specialist applications, knowledge of the typical technologystack on which modern IT solutions are based, such as theinteraction of databases (Oracle), application servers (JBOSS),middleware (Apache Tomcat, Openshift) and fat / web clients, Linuxservers and associated scripting languages (Bash)
• Result and goal orientation, especially technicalproblem-solving skills
• Ability to cooperateand deal with conflict

Thefollowing are an advantage

• Knowledgeof SQL and Java

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer
jobs_results.description:
Who we are

Aizon is an AI software provider that transforms manufacturing operations using advanced analytics, artificial intelligence, and other smart factory technologies. Our mission is to improve global health in order to change patients’ lives . We aim to do that by optimizing the way medicines are manufactured so that pharma and biotech companies can provide patients worldwide with the right medicine at the right time and at the right price. We are based in thriving San Francisco and sunny Barcelona, with customers and partners spanning the globe.

We are looking for new team members who share our values: trust, customer-centricity, innovation, integrity, collaboration, and passion.

We are embarking on an important journey, working to contribute to something impactful and new in the Life Sciences industry!

The Position

- Assuring that the platform is automatized, taken care of, and maintained efficiently

- Being responsible for Infrastructure Delivery Automation processes... in AWS

- Reporting to the Chief Platform Architect
Responsibilities
• Design, develop, and implement infrastructure on AWS using Infrastructure as Code (IaC) principles with Terraform, Terragrunt, and AWS CloudFormation.
• Automate infrastructure provisioning and management using IaC.
• Manage and optimize cloud resources for cost and performance.
• Implement continuous integration and continuous delivery (CI/CD) pipelines for infrastructure deployments and company code using tools like Jenkins, Github Actions, and Bitbucket Pipelines.
• Ensure configuration management processes and infrastructure comply with ISO 9001 and 27001 standards.
• Evaluate new technologies for potential platform improvements
• Automate infrastructure patching and vulnerability management.
• Monitor and respond to security incidents.
• Maintain Bash and Python scripts
Knowledge & Experience
• Must-have
• 3+ years of experience using AWS cloud technologies in a DevOps or similar role.
• Proficient in Infrastructure as Code (IaC), particularly with Terraform and Terragrunt.
• Strong understanding of AWS services for infrastructure provisioning, management, and security.
• Experience with CI/CD pipelines for automated deployments.
• Good scripting skills (Bash, Python, etc.)
• Experience in Windows and Linux OS
• Good problem-solving and troubleshooting skills.
• Effective communication and collaboration skills.
• Experience with CI/CD tools (Jenkins, Github, Bitbucket CI/CD).
• Nice-have
• AWS Certifications or specialty
• Docker and AWS ECR demonstrated experience
• AWS Security tools experience (Security Hub, Config, System Manager, etc.)
• Familiarity with ISO 9001 and 27001 security standards and experience working in compliant environments.
• Experience in a highly regulated industry.
• Experience automating infrastructure patching and vulnerability management.
Skills
• Proficient in spoken and written English
• Have experience working on a dynamic product that is ever-changing and evolving rapidly
• Strong analytical and creative problem-solving skills
• Ability to take smart risks and champion new ideas
• Team player, collaborative, innovative, get things done mind
• Ability to understand business requirements and translate them into technical requirements
• Show initiative in setting and meeting goals within an environment of managed change
• Commitment to Quality
• Able to deal with significant challenges, work under pressure
• Methodologic, systematic, Curious. Able to innovate
• Multitasking and responsible for your tasks, prioritizing, taking into account the business needs

We are committed to providing an inclusive environment where all employees feel mutual respect and are contributing to the good of society. We are a group of creators with diverse backgrounds (over 23 different citizenships in our company) and are proud to be an equal opportunity workplace. All employment is decided based on qualifications, merit, and business needs. If you need assistance or accommodation due to a disability, you may contact us at Ver el correo electrónico en click.appcast.io
#J-18808-Ljbffr

jobs_results.title: DevOps Engineer Senior / OTC
jobs_results.description:
Company Description

At T-Systems, you will find groundbreaking projects that contribute to social and ecological well-being. We want to welcome new talents like you, who bring fresh ideas, different perspectives, embrace challenges, and are committed to continuous learning in order to grow and make an impact on society... all in a fun way!

It doesn't matter when or where you work. It's about doing meaningful work that advances society. For this reason, we will do everything possible to ensure that you have all the development opportunities by providing a support network, excellent technology, a new work environment, and the freedom to work autonomously. We support you in growing both personally and professionally so that you can make a notable impact on society.

T-Systems is a team of around 28,000 employees worldwide, making us one of the leading global providers of end-to-end integrated solutions. We develop hybrid cloud solutions, artificial intelligence, and drive the digital... transformation of companies, industries, the public sector, and ultimately, society as a whole.

Job Description

CV in English is mandatory. We run Open Telekom Cloud! Open Telekom Cloud is a public cloud standard product based on open source community software and driven by principles of DevSecOps. Lean structures, agile methods, highly motivated teams and an extremely dynamic business environment determine our actions. With this customer-oriented and agile orientation, we are the anchor point for the Public Cloud business in Deutsche Telekom Group. We are measured by delivering a secure, stable and innovative platform. We work jointly with our platform partner and other partners out of the OpenStack ecosystem to create a highly innovative public cloud product based on European security and data protection standards. We are looking for people who are professionals and evangelists with a great deal of enthusiasm for cloud technology and who are up to the challenges created by the development and operation of a hyper-scale public cloud. We offer a unique insight into how a large public cloud works under the hood, intercultural teamwork, flat hierarchies and an independent work-style.

Implementation of web application which allows OTC (Open Telekom Cloud) users design their cloud applications and auto-deploy their applications on OTC in a few minutes. Web application also include OTC market place, which allows users develop application components (e.g., a mongo database), and import the components to the designer by themselves.

Qualifications

We are working on innovative projects. We do not need to know everything at the beginning but we learn during our work.

Requirements:
• English Intermediate+ (able to participate in technical discussions)
• Experience with Ansible
• Experience with Kubernetes
• Experience with Terraform
• Experience with OpenStack or similar solutions
• Knowledge of networking and virtualization

Optional:
• Experience in Golang
• Experience in Java Spring
• Experience with Angular
• Experience with Elasticsearch

Additional Information

What do we offer you?
• International, positive, dynamic, and motivated work environment.
• Hybrid work model (telework/face-to-face).
• Flexible schedule.
• Continuous training.
• Flexible Compensation Plan.
• Life and accident insurance.
• More than 25 working days of vacation per year.
• And many more advantages of being part of T-Systems!

If you are looking for a new challenge, do not hesitate to send us your CV! Please send CV in English. Join our team!

T-Systems Iberia will only process the CVs of candidates who meet the requirements specified for each offer

jobs_results.title: Microservices/DevOps Developer (Python)
jobs_results.description:
Req ID: 303945
Red Bee Media is the world’s leading Managed Service provider to the media industry. Working with the best media brands in the world, we enrich and ensure media experiences.

Every day, people on all continents watch television programs prepared, managed and broadcast by Red Bee Media staff. Every year, the business delivers more than 2.7 million hours of programming in more than 60 languages for nearly 600 TV channels.

We’re looking to bring in skilled, collaborative developers to share knowledge and work with exciting new technologies to create innovative solutions to make media accessible to deaf and blind audiences, as well as understanding how these technologies can enhance the value and use of media more widely.

This role works as part of the Access Services department who provides over 230,000 hours of captioning each year – more than 100,000 hours of which is live. They also provide Audio Description and signing services, making the media and the world more... accessible for the deaf and hard of hearing and hard of sight.

What do we expect from you?

The role will require feature development from base requirements and user stories, coordination with test leads and product owners to validate progress, and deployment into test and production environments. Additionally, the role will require developing integration with related systems (e.g. client scheduling software, production software) and for ensuring the optimal configuration is achieved for use in production.

What we offer:
Permanent contract
Competitive Salary Package
Stable employment on the basis of an employment contract
You will benefit from a wide range of learning opportunities and knowledgeable colleagues
clearly defined career paths
Work-based on developing the latest solutions in the area of mobile technology
Work from home, flexible working hours, laptop and mobile phone.
Work-life balance

We welcome the opportunity to meet you!

jobs_results.description: Senior DevOps Engineering - Santander Digital Services Country: España SANTANDER DIGITAL SERVICES is looking for a Senior DevOps Engineer based in one of our Hubs in Boadilla del Monte ,Cantabria and Málaga. Santander Digital Services (SDS) is the team of technology and operations at Santander. jobs_results.description:
**A propos de Talan**
• *Why Talan?**

For almost 20 years, Talan Group has been advising companies and administrations, supporting them and implementing their transformation projects in Europe, America, Africa and Asia.

Our main goal is to support organizations in their journey to the future. In Talan Spain we make it real through digital transformation.

We put people at the center, and we rely on collective intelligence, diversity, pragmatism and agility. We believe in environments based on trust, excellence, collaboration, flexibility and respect.

In addition, we lean on cultural, business, Agile and technological transformation through Artificial Intelligence, Big Data, Blockchain and RPAs.

At Talan we are looking for people like you: innovative, talented and eager to improve every day in our environment.
• *Our values**:Being, Doing, Progressing, Growing.
• *Our purpose**: By truly embracing a humanist approach to technology, we believe we can make the next digital age, an... era of progress for all.
• *Together, let’s commit.**
• *We are looking for**:
Solid knowledge in automation languages such as Python, Nodejs, Ruby
- Strong knowledge and experience in Infrastructure as code: Terraform, Ansible
- Solid knowledge in monitoring systems such as ELK, Dynatrace, Grafana
- Solid knowledge in public nubes, AWS, Azure, GCP
- Development with APIs.
- Microsoft Power Automate.
- Proven experience in CI/CD, Azure DevOPs, Jenkins, BitBucket, Git.
- Knowledge in Machine Learning and artificial intelligence.
- Analytical mindset.
• *We offer**:

- Full time and permanent employment contract in Spain, if you prefer freelance - let's talk about it
- If you are **interested in joining our team and moving to Spain**, and need some support, let's talk about it
- Smart Office Pack so you can **work from home** in a comfortable way. You can also come to our office in the Málaga Tecnological Park and have more in depth Team Building experience & meet more colleagues in person.
- Training and Career Development
- ** Benefits & Perks** like private medical insurance, life insurance, lunch and transport cards as part of the flexible remuneration pack
- Possibility to join a multicultural team & work in international project

jobs_results.title: Azure DevOps Engineer (Hybrid, Madrid based candidates ONLY)
jobs_results.description:
We are seeking a talented Azure DevOps Engineer to play a pivotal role in architecting and building our global platform infrastructure.

We are the digital bank of the Santander Group, the largest financial entity in the Euro-zone and is in the middle of a digital transformation, working in start-up format and innovating in the development of core banking products from within. We want to deliver a completely new digital experience to our customers and for this we need the most qualified professionals to join us.

As an Azure Engineer you will design and implement solutions to automate code release, building almost from scratch a cutting edge global Azure platform to support international banking.

You will have the opportunity to work with a dynamic and independent team of engineers and other areas such as Architecture, QA, Product Management and Delivery to design and develop advanced capabilities.

Mission and responsibilities:

- Design, deploy, and manage Azure infrastructure... components to support our global banking platform.

- Implement CI/CD pipelines using Azure for automated deployment and continuous integration of applications and services.

- Collaborate with development teams to optimize performance, scalability, and reliability of applications running on Azure.

- Implement monitoring and alerting solutions to ensure the health and availability of our platform.

- Drive best practices for security, compliance, and disaster recovery in the Azure environment.

- Provide technical guidance and support to internal teams on Azure-related projects and initiatives.

What are we looking for in this position?

- Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.

- +3 years of experience designing, implementing, and managing Azure infrastructure in a production environment.

- Hands-on experience with Azure, including building and managing CI/CD pipelines.

- Strong understanding of infrastructure as code (IaC) principles and tools such as Terraform.

- Proficiency in scripting languages such as PowerShell or Python.

- Experience with containerization technologies such as Docker and orchestration tools like Kubernetes.

- Knowledge of networking concepts and security best practices in Azure.

- Excellent communication skills and ability to collaborate effectively in a team environment.

Nice to have:

- Azure certifications such as Azure Solutions Architect Expert or Azure Engineer Expert.

- Experience working in the financial services industry or with regulatory compliance requirements.

- Familiarity with agile development methodologies and DevOps practices.

What do we offer?

-Immediate incorporation to a dynamic and agile company with a growth and expansion project.

-Working in start-up mode with the support of Grupo Santander.

-Competitive remuneration and attractive benefits package.

-Possibility of growth within the company and the Group.

-Collaboration in international projects and possibility of contact with different countries.

-Excellent work environment, social clubs and frequent events (now virtual).

Would you like to grow with us? Join our team!

We are an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered as equal without paying attention to gender identity, sexual orientation, ethnicity, religion, age, political orientation, union membership nor disability status.

We make recruiting decisions based on your experience and skills. We value your passion to discover, invent, simplify and build.

If you´re not currently living in Madrid and you are open to relocate, we would still love to consider your application

Join us in revolutionizing the digital banking experience for customers worldwide. Apply now to be a part of our innovative team!

jobs_results.title: Junior IAM DevOps Developer
jobs_results.description:
OSP (Otto Group Solution Provider) is an IT service provider for retail and logistics with headquarters in Dresden. We live our passion for IT in an appreciative, trusting work environment. What drives us is the idea of working together as a team to achieve great things for our customers.

We rely on the personal responsibility and willingness to learn of our employees, on modern technologies and high quality in software development. Agile working, transparent decisions, a lively feedback culture and collegial cooperation make us successful.

We are active for customers inside and outside the Otto Group. With over 450 employees at several German and international locations, we have been developing flexible software and BI solutions since 1991 and are thus shaping the shopping worlds of tomorrow. We are part of the Otto Group and share a value system that focuses on responsible and sustainable action.

What will you do?
• Our team take care of workplace-related hardware, collaboration... platforms such as M365 and communication services - with state-of-the-art technology that fits perfectly. In particular, we - the Automation Services team - are part of the division responsible for the operation and further development of the Identity and Access Management (IAM).
• Our platform ensures that everyone has all the hardware, software, and access rights needed to be productive in the given moment.
• We ensure the complete and automated User Life Cycle for all colleagues - for joiners, movers and leavers.
• You would be part of a team with 12 highly motivated experts looking forward to work with you and bring you up to speed with our IAM world!

What's your story?
• You have a high customer focus.
• You are highly motivated to ensure our operations quality and service availability (DevOps).
• You have basic knowledge in back and front-end development.
• You have very good knowledge of English speaking and writing.

Nice to have:
- Basic knowledge of SQL, Active Directory, as well as interface programming.
Basic knowledge of One Identity, Azure, AWS, GCP, ….

Contact

Mariel Mantecas
Otto Group Solution Provider Spain S.L.
Calle del Conde de Peñalver 38, 1ª planta | 28006 Madrid
mariel.mantecas(at)ottogroup.com
